But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me. 2 CORINTHIANS 12:9 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ 2 CORINTHIANS 12
O! ’twas a cheering word indeed! Exactly suited to my need; “Sufficient for thee is my grace, Thy weakness my great pow’r displays.” STANZA IV
